reworkQueue.resolution: FIXED under its own packet, bugs/BUG-038-progress-timeout-bsd-wc-padding/. Root cause: BSD wc right-pads its count in a fixed-width field, so current_size="$(wc -c < "$log_file")" in bubbles_run_with_progress_timeout (bubbles/scripts/guard-lib.sh) failed the ^[0-9]+$ test on the first poll of every BSD host and returned rc=2 before either deadline was evaluated. Fix: normalize with current_size="${current_size//[[:space:]]/}" before the numeric test - fork-free, no macOS special-case. Present at bubbles/scripts/guard-lib.sh:137.
